name: Trochanteric Bursitis
definition: Inflammation or irritation of a trochanteric bursa causing lateral hip pain; many cases overlap with greater trochanteric pain syndrome and gluteal tendinopathy.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is usually clinical; ultrasound/MRI is reserved for atypical or persistent cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Injection may be considered selectively but should complement rehabilitation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni/Kati lateral pain phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation or irritation of a trochanteric bursa causing lateral hip pain; many cases overlap with greater trochanteric pain syndrome and gluteal tendinopathy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
